features: 10000mAh High-Capacity Power Bank – Stay powered throughout the day with a compact yet powerful 10000mAh battery that keeps your smartphone, tablet, or accessories charged on the go.
22.5W Fast Charging with Mach Charge Technology – Experience blazing-fast charging with 22.5W output power and advanced Mach Charge support, ensuring your devices get charged quickly and efficiently.
Dual Output Ports (Type-C + USB-A) – Charge two devices at once with smart dual output support, making it the perfect companion for multitaskers and travelers.
Type-C PD Input/Output – The reversible Type-C port supports both fast input charging for the power bank itself and PD output to charge your gadgets at high speed.
Digital LED Display – Get real-time battery percentage updates on a bright digital display, so you always know exactly how much power is left.
Wake-Up Button for Instant Access – Easily check battery levels or activate charging with a single press, thanks to the convenient wake-up button.
Sleek & Travel-Friendly Design – Compact, lightweight, and stylishly designed, Luxcell B is easy to carry in your pocket or bag, perfect for everyday use and travel.
